narration.text: A family's delayed flights, claimed under EU 261. This is a chore for a family of four in Lisbon that flew fourteen times this year, two airlines, one baby on a lap. Athena works it across 4 portals: Tripfold itineraries, Mailnest, Aerolark claims and Skyrail claims. On the bench, she found 4 of 4 eligible items, worth 5,445 dollars of the 5,445 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 9 traps, and she walked past 9. Among them: A flight four hours late because thunderstorms closed Berlin's airport: an extraordinary circumstance, so nothing is owed. A flight that left three hours late and reached the gate two hours and 48 minutes late: the arrival is what counts. She took 3 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 4 hours, so she was about 77 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
